title: Waypoint-1.5: A Real-Time Video World Model for Consumer Hardware
title_zh: 实时视频生成模型 Waypoint-1.5 发布

paragraphs.en: We present Waypoint-1.5 , a real-time diffusion world model for interactive video generation on consumer-grade hardware. Unlike general video diffusion models, interactive world models (iWMs) must respond to dense user controls under strict latency and throughput constraints. Waypoint-1.5 is pre-trained on 100,000 hours of diverse, control-aligned video game data across hundreds of games, and generates playable video conditioned on full keyboard and mouse input. The model includes two resolution variants that run across a wide spectrum of consumer hardware. To characterize this unique setting, we distinguish rendered FPS, latent FPS, and control rate. We describe the data pipeline, architecture, training methodology, and runtime system behind Waypoint-1.5. We evaluate interactivity through latency and throughput. We conclude with a discussion of the safety and ethical considerations unique to iWMs.

paragraphs.en: Neural networks are now capable of synthesizing coherent visual dynamics across space and time, as recent progress in generative video models has demonstrated. Impressive results in visual quality, temporal consistency, and prompt adherence have been achieved by systems including WAN ( [ 22 ] ), Hunyuan Video ( [ 12 ] ), LTX-Video ( [ 9 ] ), and comparable models. These models, however, are built mainly for offline text-guided video generation. Accordingly, prompt adherence, visual fidelity, and temporal coherence serve as the natural evaluation axes, measured by metrics such as VideoBench ( [ 14 ] ) and FVD ( [ 21 ] ). What this form of video generation does not offer is interactivity: users cannot actively steer the environment in real time through low-latency actions like keyboard and mouse inputs, but must instead rely on static text prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 正如生成式视频模型的最新进展所展示的，神经网络现在已能在空间和时间上合成连贯的视觉动态。 包括 WAN（[22]）、混元视频（Hunyuan Video，[12]）、LTX-Video（[9]）以及类似模型在内的系统，在视觉质量、时间一致性和提示词遵循方面都取得了令人瞩目的成果。 然而，这些模型主要是为离线的文本引导视频生成而构建的。 因此，提示词遵循、视觉保真度和时间连贯性成为天然的评估维度，并通过 VideoBench（[14]）和 FVD（[21]）等指标来衡量。 这种视频生成形式所不具备的是交互性：用户无法通过键盘和鼠标输入等低延迟操作实时主动地操控环境，而只能依赖静态的文本提示。

paragraphs.en: However, there is a large hurdle to cross between research demonstrations and deployment in real-world systems. A large chunk of the existing video world models require enterprise level inference infrastructure (e.g H200s, B200s), yet cannot achieve high FPS or long-horizon rollouts with sufficient action adherence. In order for video world models to become a practical tool in domains such as game development, creative applications, immersive entertainment, and physical AI (e.g robotics, self-driving), it is critical that they must run on consumer grade hardware (e.g RTX 4090).

paragraphs.en: With this problem in mind, we present Waypoint-1.5 , a video world model built from the ground up for real-time inference on consumer GPUs. Our model comprises a single-stream causal Diffusion Transformer (DiT) trained in the latent space of a distilled autoencoder, with design choices centered around the latency and throughput requirements for real-time interactive generation on consumer hardware. Our training methodology includes causal diffusion forcing pretraining, NorMuon optimization, and sequence packing to maximize GPU utilization. Together, these choices allow Waypoint-1.5 to excel and run in real time on a wide range of consumer GPUs (see Section 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一问题，我们提出了 Waypoint-1.5，一个从零开始为消费级 GPU 上的实时推理而构建的视频世界模型。 我们的模型由一个单流因果扩散Transformer（Diffusion Transformer, DiT）组成，在蒸馏自编码器的潜空间中训练，其设计选择围绕在消费级硬件上进行实时交互式生成所需的延迟与吞吐量要求展开。 我们的训练方法包括因果扩散强迫预训练、NorMuon 优化以及序列打包，以最大化 GPU 利用率。 这些选择共同使 Waypoint-1.5 能够在广泛的消费级 GPU 上实时表现出色并运行（参见第 8 节）。

paragraphs.en: In this technical report, we describe the model architecture (Section 2 ), pretraining methodology and input conditioning (Section 3 ), post-training distillation (Section 4 ), inference system (Section 5 ), autoencoder design (Section 6 ), data pipeline (Section 7 ), evaluation (Section 8 ), and safety considerations (Section 9 ).

paragraphs.en: We use TAEHV-1.5 to encode video frames into latents which compresses spatially by 16 × 16\times and temporally by 4 × 4\times . A 512 × 1024 512\times 1024 frame, for example, yields a 32 × 64 32\times 64 latent, while a 256 × 512 256\times 512 frame yields a 16 × 32 16\times 32 latent. Each latent has 32 channels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 TAEHV-1.5 将视频帧编码为潜变量，其空间压缩率为 16 × 16\times，时间压缩率为 4 × 4\times。 例如，一个 512 × 1024 512\times 1024 的帧会生成 32 × 64 32\times 64 的潜变量，而一个 256 × 512 256\times 512 的帧会生成 16 × 32 16\times 32 的潜变量。 每个潜变量有 32 个通道。

paragraphs.en: We use factorized spatiotemporal attention wherein within each latent, tokens may attend bidirectionally to all other tokens. Across latents, a causal mask is applied using FlexAttention, which enables efficient and temporally autoregressive generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用分解式的时空注意力机制，其中在每个隐变量内部，词元可以双向关注所有其他词元。 在隐变量之间，通过 FlexAttention 应用因果掩码，从而实现高效的、时间上自回归的生成。

paragraphs.en: To balance short-term local context with long-range temporal coherence, we use a two-level attention hierarchy:
paragraphs.zh: 为了在短期局部上下文与长期时间一致性之间取得平衡，我们采用了两级注意力层次结构：

paragraphs.en: Local window : each frame densely attends to the preceding 16 frames.
paragraphs.zh: 局部窗口：每帧密集地关注其前面的 16 帧。

paragraphs.en: Global dilated window : every 4th block also attends to a set of evenly-spaced frames within a 128-frame context window, using a pinned dilation factor of 8. This sparse global attention efficiently covers long-range context without quadratic memory growth.
paragraphs.zh: 全局膨胀窗口：每第4个块还会使用固定为8的膨胀因子，关注128帧上下文窗口内一组均匀分布的帧。 这种稀疏全局注意力以高效的方式覆盖长程上下文，而不会导致内存呈二次方增长。

sents.en: Global dilated window : every 4th block also attends to a set of evenly-spaced frames within a 128-frame context window, using a pinned dilation factor of 8.
sents.zh: 全局膨胀窗口：每第4个块还会使用固定为8的膨胀因子，关注128帧上下文窗口内一组均匀分布的帧。

sents.en: This sparse global attention efficiently covers long-range context without quadratic memory growth.
sents.zh: 这种稀疏全局注意力以高效的方式覆盖长程上下文，而不会导致内存呈二次方增长。

paragraphs.en: During inference, a static ring-buffer KV-cache stores the key-value representations of past fully denoised frames. Noisy intermediate frames during multi-step denoising are not cached. The cache is pre-allocated to a fixed capacity to prevent unbounded VRAM growth: for local attention layers, a dense ring of 16 frames is maintained, with the oldest frame evicted when a new one is committed. Every 4th block uses global dilated attention with a 128-frame ring and a fixed dilation of 8, meaning new frames evict older ones at regular intervals rather than simply discarding the oldest.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，静态环形缓冲区KV缓存存储过去已完全去噪帧的键值表示。 多步去噪过程中的噪声中间帧不会被缓存。 该缓存被预先分配为固定容量，以防止显存无限增长：对于局部注意力层，维护一个16帧的密集环形缓冲区，当提交新帧时淘汰最旧的帧。 每第4个块使用128帧环形缓冲区和固定扩张率为8的全局扩张注意力，这意味着新帧会以固定间隔淘汰较旧的帧，而不是简单地丢弃最旧的帧。

paragraphs.en: In order to reduce the KV memory footprint and memory bandwidth, we use Grouped Query Attention (GQA) [ 2 ] with 32 query heads and 16 key-value heads (2:1 ratio). This halves the KV memory footprint relative to standard multi-head attention.
paragraphs.zh: 为了降低 KV 内存占用和内存带宽，我们采用分组查询注意力（GQA）[2]，其中包含 32 个查询头和 16 个键值头（2:1 的比例）。 这使得 KV 内存占用相比标准多头注意力减半。

paragraphs.en: Direct inference with the pretrained Waypoint-1.5 model runs into two problems. The first is compute: each frame requires solving a multi-step ODE (typically 60 solver steps), and classifier-free guidance doubles the effective step count by requiring independent forward passes for conditioned and unconditioned predictions, bringing the effective inference cost to ∼ \sim 120 forward passes per frame. The second is exposure bias : the model is trained on ground-truth context frames corrupted with varying noise, but at inference it must condition on its own imperfect predictions from prior steps. This mismatch causes visual drift and incoherence over long rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 使用预训练的 Waypoint-1.5 模型进行直接推断会遇到两个问题。 第一个是计算量：每一帧都需要求解一个多步常微分方程（通常需要 60 个求解器步），而无分类器引导需要对有条件和无条件预测分别进行独立的前向传播，使有效步数翻倍，将每帧的有效推断成本推高至约 120 次前向传播。 第二个是曝光偏差：模型是在以不同噪声损坏的真值上下文帧上训练的，但在推断时它必须以自身先前步骤产生的不完美预测作为条件。 这种不匹配会导致长时序展开中的视觉漂移和不连贯性。

paragraphs.en: with ω ctrl = 15.0 \omega_{\text{ctrl}}=15.0 , ω ctx = 2.0 \omega_{\text{ctx}}=2.0 , and v ∅ v_{\varnothing} the unconditioned prediction. The student learns to match this guided distribution directly, removing the need to compute v ∅ v_{\varnothing} at inference. paragraphs.en: To compute gradients over autoregressive sequences without costly per-frame backward passes, we use sequence-packed teacher forcing : context and current frames are concatenated into a single forward pass, with a binary mask distinguishing context-only tokens ( cid = 0 \texttt{cid}=0 , no gradient) from gradient-carrying tokens ( cid = 1 \texttt{cid}=1 ). paragraphs.en: Waypoint-1.5 generates video autoregressively, producing one latent frame at a time. At each step, the model receives a single noisy frame and all controller inputs for that frame, and denoises it conditioned on the full history of past clean frames. Rather than re-encoding the entire history at every step, we use a static rolling KV cache that stores key-value representations of past frames and is updated incrementally.
paragraphs.zh: Waypoint-1.5 以自回归方式生成视频，每次生成一个潜在帧。 在每一步中，模型接收单帧噪声帧以及该帧的所有控制器输入，并以过去干净帧的完整历史为条件对其进行去噪。 我们没有在每一步都对整个历史重新编码，而是使用静态滚动 KV 缓存来存储过去帧的键值表示，并对其进行增量更新。

paragraphs.en: The cache is structured as a ring buffer per transformer layer. Each layer maintains a buffer of capacity ( L + t pf ) (L+t_{\mathrm{pf}}) token slots, where L L is the layer’s context window in tokens and t pf t_{\mathrm{pf}} is the number of tokens per frame. The final t pf t_{\mathrm{pf}} slots form a dedicated tail that always holds the current frame under active denoising. During multi-step denoising, the cache is frozen: the tail is written on every denoising step (allowing the model to attend to the current noisy frame), but the ring buffer is not updated. Once the frame is fully denoised to σ = 0 \sigma=0 , the cache is unfrozen and the clean frame is committed to the ring. This ensures the persistent context consists exclusively of fully denoised frames, avoiding error accumulation from noisy context frames.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存被结构化为每个 transformer 层一个环形缓冲区。 每层维护一个容量为 ( L + t pf ) (L+t_{\mathrm{pf}}) 个 token 槽位的缓冲区，其中 L L 是该层的上下文窗口（以 token 计），t pf t_{\mathrm{pf}} 是每帧的 token 数量。 最后 t pf t_{\mathrm{pf}} 个槽位构成一个专用尾部，始终保存在主动去噪下的当前帧。 在多步去噪过程中，缓存被冻结：尾部在每一步去噪时都会被写入（使模型能够关注当前含噪帧），但环形缓冲区不会更新。 一旦该帧被完全去噪至 σ = 0 \sigma=0，缓存即被解冻，干净帧被提交到环形缓冲区。 这确保了持久上下文仅由完全去噪的帧组成，避免含噪上下文帧导致的误差累积。

paragraphs.en: The pretrained model uses 60 denoising steps per frame with a flow-matching Euler scheduler. A shift of 3.0 applied to the noise schedule compresses it toward lower noise levels, concentrating the sampling budget in the refinement regime. CFG is applied at each step by running a conditioned and unconditioned forward pass and combining them with a guidance weight, doubling the effective per-frame cost to 60 × 2 = 120 60\times 2=120 model evaluations per frame.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练模型对每一帧使用60个去噪步骤，并采用流匹配的Euler调度器。 对噪声调度施加3.0的偏移会将其压缩到较低的噪声水平，从而把采样预算集中在精炼阶段。 CFG在每一步都通过运行一次有条件前向传播和一次无条件前向传播，并用引导权重将二者结合来实现，这将每帧的有效成本翻倍，达到每帧60 × 2 = 120 60\times 2=120 次模型评估。

paragraphs.en: The frozen-cache denoising step and the unfrozen cache-writing step are compiled ahead of time with torch.compile , using max-autotune mode with full graph capture and static shapes. This enables kernel fusion, memory layout optimization, and CUDA graph capture, eliminating Python dispatch overhead on each forward pass. paragraphs.en: Waypoint-1.5 encodes video into a compact latent representation using TAEHV 1.5 [ 4 ] , a tiny autoencoder designed to approximate the latent space of the Hunyuan VAE 1.5. TAEHV 1.5 applies spatial downsampling alongside a temporal compression factor of 4, mapping 60 raw FPS to 15 latent frames per second. The encoder produces 32-channel latent frames, significantly more compact than the original VAE latent. For a 512 × \times 1024 input clip the encoded latent has spatial dimensions 32 × 64 32\times 64 , and for a 256 × \times 512 input clip it is 16 × 32 16\times 32 . This compression reduces a 13-second video clip (768 raw frames) to 192 latent frames, making transformer-scale training over long sequences tractable.

paragraphs.en: Standard high-fidelity autoencoders are designed for quality rather than throughput, and naive inference can make the decode step a significant bottleneck in a real-time pipeline. TAEHV 1.5 sidesteps this by design: as a tiny distilled approximation of the full Hunyuan VAE 1.5, it trades a small amount of reconstruction fidelity for a dramatically reduced parameter count and arithmetic cost. Inference runs in FP16, achieving approximately 800 FPS decode throughput on an NVIDIA RTX 5090, fast enough to make decoder overhead negligible relative to the diffusion model.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的高保真自编码器是为质量而非吞吐量设计的，朴素的推理方式会使解码步骤成为实时流水线中的重大瓶颈。 TAEHV 1.5 从设计上规避了这一点：作为完整 Hunyuan VAE 1.5 的微型蒸馏近似版本，它以少量重建保真度为代价，大幅降低了参数量和算术成本。 推理以 FP16 运行，在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上实现约 800 FPS 的解码吞吐量，其速度之快使解码器的开销相对于扩散模型而言可以忽略不计。

paragraphs.en: Waypoint-1.5 is trained on Owl-Control , a proprietary dataset of controller-synchronized video game footage comprising over 100,000 hours of gameplay across hundreds of distinct games. Each recording pairs high-fidelity visual observations with the full controller input stream that produced them, enabling the model to learn a grounded mapping from game state to player action.
paragraphs.zh: Waypoint-1.5 在 Owl-Control 上进行训练，这是一个专有的数据集，包含与控制器同步的视频游戏画面，涵盖数百款不同游戏、超过 100,000 小时的游戏过程。 每段录像都将高保真的视觉观察与产生这些观察的完整控制器输入流配对，使模型能够学习从游戏状态到玩家动作的接地映射。

paragraphs.en: The preprocessing pipeline is illustrated in Figure 4 . Raw 60 FPS RGB video is processed offline through the TAEHV 1.5 encoder at a 4 × \times temporal compression factor, producing latent sequences at 15 frames per second. In parallel, the high-frequency controller stream is aligned to the latent frame grid and bucketed into 15 snapshots per second. Each snapshot encodes the full button state vector (256-bucket discretization), the net mouse displacement ( Δ ​ x , Δ ​ y ) (\Delta x,\Delta y) accumulated since the previous snapshot, and the scroll direction. The resulting paired clips (latent frames and controller sequences) are stored in a preprocessed format for efficient data loading.
paragraphs.zh: 预处理流程如图 4 所示。 原始 60 FPS RGB 视频通过 TAEHV 1.5 编码器离线处理，采用 4 × \times 时间压缩因子，生成每秒 15 帧的潜变量序列。 与此同时，高频控制器流被对齐到潜变量帧网格，并按每秒 15 个快照进行分桶。 每个快照编码完整的按键状态向量（256 桶离散化）、自上一个快照以来累积的鼠标净位移 ( Δ ​ x , Δ ​ y ) (\Delta x,\Delta y)，以及滚轮方向。 所得的成对片段（潜变量帧和控制器序列）以预处理格式存储，以便高效加载数据。

paragraphs.en: To maximize GPU utilization and minimize padding waste during training, we apply cross-document sequence packing: latent sequences from multiple game clips are concatenated into a single training sequence with document IDs tracked per token. Attention masking prevents information from crossing clip boundaries, preserving the causal structure across packed sequences while allowing the model to train on long effective context windows without padding overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在训练过程中最大化 GPU 利用率并减少填充浪费，我们采用跨文档序列打包：将来自多个游戏片段的 latent 序列拼接成单一训练序列，并为每个 token 记录其文档 ID。 注意力掩码防止信息跨越片段边界，在保留打包序列的因果结构的同时，使模型能够在长有效上下文窗口上训练而无需承担填充开销。

paragraphs.en: The central design objective of Waypoint-1.5 is real-time interactive generation on consumer hardware. We therefore evaluate the system primarily on throughput, measured in latent frames per second (latent FPS) across a range of consumer NVIDIA GPUs. Latent FPS measures the rate at which the diffusion model generates latent frames; pixel-space video is subsequently decoded by the TAEHV 1.5 autoencoder at approximately 800 FPS, adding negligible overhead. Latent FPS is therefore responsible for governing the interactive responsiveness of the system.

paragraphs.en: At 720P, INT8-quantized Waypoint-1.5 meets the 30 latent FPS threshold on all GPUs from the RTX 5060 Ti upward. paragraphs.en: Safety in interactive world models presents challenges distinct from those in text, image, or even video generation systems. Unlike models that produce a single static output, world models generate persistent environments at high frame rates that respond continuously to user input. A single prompt can yield minutes of interactive content spanning diverse visual states, making post-hoc output review insufficient on its own. Safety must therefore be addressed across the full pipeline: in the training data, at prompt ingestion, during generation, at output delivery, and through ongoing monitoring.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式世界模型的安全性与文本、图像乃至视频生成系统所面临的安全挑战截然不同。 与产生单一静态输出的模型不同，世界模型以高帧率生成持久的环境，并对用户输入持续做出响应。 一个单一的提示词就能产生长达数分钟、涵盖多种视觉状态的交互内容，这使得仅靠事后输出审查是不够的。 因此，安全必须在整条流水线中得到处理：在训练数据中、在提示词摄取时、在生成过程中、在输出交付时，以及通过持续的监控来实现。

sents.en: Safety in interactive world models presents challenges distinct from those in text, image, or even video generation systems.
sents.zh: 交互式世界模型的安全性与文本、图像乃至视频生成系统所面临的安全挑战截然不同。

sents.en: Unlike models that produce a single static output, world models generate persistent environments at high frame rates that respond continuously to user input.
sents.zh: 与产生单一静态输出的模型不同，世界模型以高帧率生成持久的环境，并对用户输入持续做出响应。

sents.en: A single prompt can yield minutes of interactive content spanning diverse visual states, making post-hoc output review insufficient on its own.
sents.zh: 一个单一的提示词就能产生长达数分钟、涵盖多种视觉状态的交互内容，这使得仅靠事后输出审查是不够的。

sents.en: Safety must therefore be addressed across the full pipeline: in the training data, at prompt ingestion, during generation, at output delivery, and through ongoing monitoring.
sents.zh: 因此，安全必须在整条流水线中得到处理：在训练数据中、在提示词摄取时、在生成过程中、在输出交付时，以及通过持续的监控来实现。

paragraphs.en: Safety has been part of the development process from the beginning. Rather than treating it as a post-deployment addition, we have built layered safeguards into each stage of the Waypoint pipeline. This section describes those layers, the tradeoffs involved, and our plans for continued improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 安全性从一开始就是开发流程的一部分。 我们没有将其视为部署后的附加项，而是在 Waypoint 流水线的每个阶段都内置了分层防护措施。 本节将介绍这些防护层、其中涉及的权衡，以及我们持续改进的计划。

sents.zh: 安全性从一开始就是开发流程的一部分。

sents.en: Rather than treating it as a post-deployment addition, we have built layered safeguards into each stage of the Waypoint pipeline.
sents.zh: 我们没有将其视为部署后的附加项，而是在 Waypoint 流水线的每个阶段都内置了分层防护措施。

sents.en: This section describes those layers, the tradeoffs involved, and our plans for continued improvement.
sents.zh: 本节将介绍这些防护层、其中涉及的权衡，以及我们持续改进的计划。

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge that safety in generative systems involves inherent tensions between creative freedom and content restriction, between open research and controlled deployment, and between moving quickly as a startup and building robust safeguards. We do not claim to have resolved these tensions. Instead, we describe the systems we have built so far and the framework under which we continue to iterate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们承认，生成式系统的安全性涉及创造性自由与内容限制之间的内在张力、开放研究与受控部署之间的内在张力，以及作为初创公司快速推进与构建稳健防护措施之间的内在张力。 我们并不声称已经解决了这些张力。 相反，我们描述了到目前为止我们已构建的系统，以及我们在其下持续迭代的框架。

sents.en: We acknowledge that safety in generative systems involves inherent tensions between creative freedom and content restriction, between open research and controlled deployment, and between moving quickly as a startup and building robust safeguards.
sents.zh: 我们承认，生成式系统的安全性涉及创造性自由与内容限制之间的内在张力、开放研究与受控部署之间的内在张力，以及作为初创公司快速推进与构建稳健防护措施之间的内在张力。

sents.en: We do not claim to have resolved these tensions.
sents.zh: 我们并不声称已经解决了这些张力。

sents.zh: 相反，我们描述了到目前为止我们已构建的系统，以及我们在其下持续迭代的框架。

paragraphs.en: Waypoint-1.5 underwent a structured safety review before release. We conducted internal testing to identify known failure modes, calibrate filtering thresholds, and evaluate the model’s behavior under adversarial prompting. A soft, controlled release was conducted via our self-hosted streaming service to evaluate how users attempt to circumvent safeguards or telegraph intended use.
paragraphs.zh: Waypoint-1.5 在发布前经过了结构化的安全审查。 我们进行了内部测试，以识别已知失效模式、校准过滤阈值，并评估模型在对抗性提示下的行为。 我们通过自托管的流式服务进行了软性、受控的发布，以评估用户尝试绕过安全防护措施或预先透露其预期用途的情况。

sents.en: Waypoint-1.5 underwent a structured safety review before release.
sents.zh: Waypoint-1.5 在发布前经过了结构化的安全审查。

sents.en: We conducted internal testing to identify known failure modes, calibrate filtering thresholds, and evaluate the model’s behavior under adversarial prompting.
sents.zh: 我们进行了内部测试，以识别已知失效模式、校准过滤阈值，并评估模型在对抗性提示下的行为。

sents.en: A soft, controlled release was conducted via our self-hosted streaming service to evaluate how users attempt to circumvent safeguards or telegraph intended use.
sents.zh: 我们通过自托管的流式服务进行了软性、受控的发布，以评估用户尝试绕过安全防护措施或预先透露其预期用途的情况。

paragraphs.en: Safety review is not a single gate but a recurring cycle. Waypoint-1.5 incorporated lessons from prior deployment, including observed user behavior patterns, attempted jailbreaks, and content distribution analysis from real-world usage.
paragraphs.zh: 安全审查不是单一关卡，而是一个循环往复的周期。 Waypoint-1.5 吸取了此前部署的经验教训，包括在真实使用中观察到的用户行为模式、尝试进行的越狱攻击，以及内容分发分析。

sents.en: Safety review is not a single gate but a recurring cycle.
sents.zh: 安全审查不是单一关卡，而是一个循环往复的周期。

sents.en: Waypoint-1.5 incorporated lessons from prior deployment, including observed user behavior patterns, attempted jailbreaks, and content distribution analysis from real-world usage.
sents.zh: Waypoint-1.5 吸取了此前部署的经验教训，包括在真实使用中观察到的用户行为模式、尝试进行的越狱攻击，以及内容分发分析。

paragraphs.en: Training data and the decisions surrounding the data included in training is the first step towards ensuring safety. We apply source-level filtering before any data enter the training pipeline. This includes excluding sources known to contain disproportionate amounts of personally identifiable information (PII), adult content, or content that violates terms of service.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据以及围绕训练所含数据做出的决策，是确保安全性的第一步。 在任何数据进入训练流程之前，我们都会进行源级过滤。 这包括排除已知含有不成比例的大量个人身份信息（PII）、成人内容或违反服务条款内容的来源。

sents.en: Training data and the decisions surrounding the data included in training is the first step towards ensuring safety.
sents.zh: 训练数据以及围绕训练所含数据做出的决策，是确保安全性的第一步。

sents.en: We apply source-level filtering before any data enter the training pipeline.
sents.zh: 在任何数据进入训练流程之前，我们都会进行源级过滤。

sents.en: This includes excluding sources known to contain disproportionate amounts of personally identifiable information (PII), adult content, or content that violates terms of service.
sents.zh: 这包括排除已知含有不成比例的大量个人身份信息（PII）、成人内容或违反服务条款内容的来源。

paragraphs.en: Domain selection is guided by the model’s intended use case. We are primarily concerned with creating an interactive entertainment experience and enabling creative use. We prioritize sources whose content distribution aligns with that goal.
paragraphs.zh: 领域的选择以模型的预期用例为指导。 我们主要关注打造互动娱乐体验并支持创造性使用。 我们优先选择内容分发与该目标一致的来源。

sents.en: Domain selection is guided by the model’s intended use case.
sents.zh: 领域的选择以模型的预期用例为指导。

sents.en: We are primarily concerned with creating an interactive entertainment experience and enabling creative use.
sents.zh: 我们主要关注打造互动娱乐体验并支持创造性使用。

sents.en: We prioritize sources whose content distribution aligns with that goal.
sents.zh: 我们优先选择内容分发与该目标一致的来源。

paragraphs.en: Beyond source-level curation, we perform clip-level and frame-level analysis of the pretraining corpus. We built a video scanning pipeline that processes the full dataset using a multi-stage classification approach. The pipeline runs two classifiers sequentially: a ResNet-50-based explicit content detector and a CLIP-based classifier (ViT-B/32) queried with prompts targeting potential depictions of minors across photorealistic, cartoon, and stylized formats.
paragraphs.zh: 在源级筛选之外，我们对预训练语料进行了片段级和帧级的分析。 我们构建了一个视频扫描流水线，采用多阶段分类方法处理整个数据集。 该流水线依次运行两个分类器：一个基于 ResNet-50 的显式内容检测器，以及一个基于 CLIP 的分类器（ViT-B/32），该分类器通过面向照片级真实、卡通和风格化格式中可能涉及未成年人描绘的提示进行查询。

sents.en: Beyond source-level curation, we perform clip-level and frame-level analysis of the pretraining corpus.
sents.zh: 在源级筛选之外，我们对预训练语料进行了片段级和帧级的分析。

sents.en: We built a video scanning pipeline that processes the full dataset using a multi-stage classification approach.
sents.zh: 我们构建了一个视频扫描流水线，采用多阶段分类方法处理整个数据集。

sents.en: The pipeline runs two classifiers sequentially: a ResNet-50-based explicit content detector and a CLIP-based classifier (ViT-B/32) queried with prompts targeting potential depictions of minors across photorealistic, cartoon, and stylized formats.
sents.zh: 该流水线依次运行两个分类器：一个基于 ResNet-50 的显式内容检测器，以及一个基于 CLIP 的分类器（ViT-B/32），该分类器通过面向照片级真实、卡通和风格化格式中可能涉及未成年人描绘的提示进行查询。

paragraphs.en: Each processed video produces structured metadata recording flagged frames by category and a determination of whether the clip should be excluded from training. This frame-level approach avoids the blunt removal of entire clips when only isolated frames are problematic, preserving useful training signal while removing unsafe content.
paragraphs.zh: 每个处理后的视频都会生成结构化元数据，按类别记录被标记的帧，并判断该片段是否应从训练中排除。 这种帧级别的方法避免了在只有个别帧有问题时生硬地移除整个片段，在去除不安全内容的同时保留了有用的训练信号。

sents.en: Each processed video produces structured metadata recording flagged frames by category and a determination of whether the clip should be excluded from training.
sents.zh: 每个处理后的视频都会生成结构化元数据，按类别记录被标记的帧，并判断该片段是否应从训练中排除。

sents.en: This frame-level approach avoids the blunt removal of entire clips when only isolated frames are problematic, preserving useful training signal while removing unsafe content.
sents.zh: 这种帧级别的方法避免了在只有个别帧有问题时生硬地移除整个片段，在去除不安全内容的同时保留了有用的训练信号。

paragraphs.en: Flagged content above confidence thresholds is downloaded and manually reviewed before final calibration, resulting in a dataset corpora with metadata which can be audited. This metadata also enables retrospective analysis: if filtering criteria change in future releases, previously processed data can be re-evaluated without full reprocessing.
paragraphs.zh: 高于置信度阈值的被标记内容会被下载并经过人工审核后才进行最终校准，从而形成带有可审计元数据的数据语料库。 这些元数据还支持回溯性分析：如果未来版本中的过滤标准发生变化，可以先前处理过的数据进行重新评估，而无需完整的重新处理。

sents.en: Flagged content above confidence thresholds is downloaded and manually reviewed before final calibration, resulting in a dataset corpora with metadata which can be audited.
sents.zh: 高于置信度阈值的被标记内容会被下载并经过人工审核后才进行最终校准，从而形成带有可审计元数据的数据语料库。

sents.en: This metadata also enables retrospective analysis: if filtering criteria change in future releases, previously processed data can be re-evaluated without full reprocessing.
sents.zh: 这些元数据还支持回溯性分析：如果未来版本中的过滤标准发生变化，可以先前处理过的数据进行重新评估，而无需完整的重新处理。

paragraphs.en: User prompts pass through an intermediate sanitation layer before reaching the world model. This layer serves a dual purpose: 1) safety enforcement and 2) structural alignment with the model’s training distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 用户提示在到达世界模型之前，会先经过一个中间净化层。 该层具有双重目的：1）执行安全策略；2）使输入结构与模型的训练分布保持一致。

sents.en: User prompts pass through an intermediate sanitation layer before reaching the world model.
sents.zh: 用户提示在到达世界模型之前，会先经过一个中间净化层。

sents.en: This layer serves a dual purpose: 1) safety enforcement and 2) structural alignment with the model’s training distribution.
sents.zh: 该层具有双重目的：1）执行安全策略；2）使输入结构与模型的训练分布保持一致。

paragraphs.en: On the safety side, the sanitizer detects and transforms prompts containing references to explicit sexual content, depictions of minors, celebrity likeness, recognizable branded intellectual property, and other content categories. Rather than rejecting prompts outright, the system rewrites user intent into a safe environmental description suitable for generation. For example, a prompt referencing a specific copyrighted work is transformed into a description that captures the intended aesthetic without producing derivative content.
paragraphs.zh: 在安全方面，净化器会检测并转换包含涉及露骨色情内容、未成年人描绘、名人肖像、可识别品牌知识产权及其他内容类别的提示词。 系统并非直接拒绝提示词，而是将用户意图改写为适合生成的安全环境描述。 例如，引用特定受版权保护作品的提示词会被转换为一段描述，该描述在保留预期美学风格的同时不会产生衍生内容。

sents.en: On the safety side, the sanitizer detects and transforms prompts containing references to explicit sexual content, depictions of minors, celebrity likeness, recognizable branded intellectual property, and other content categories.
sents.zh: 在安全方面，净化器会检测并转换包含涉及露骨色情内容、未成年人描绘、名人肖像、可识别品牌知识产权及其他内容类别的提示词。

sents.en: Rather than rejecting prompts outright, the system rewrites user intent into a safe environmental description suitable for generation.
sents.zh: 系统并非直接拒绝提示词，而是将用户意图改写为适合生成的安全环境描述。

sents.en: For example, a prompt referencing a specific copyrighted work is transformed into a description that captures the intended aesthetic without producing derivative content.
sents.zh: 例如，引用特定受版权保护作品的提示词会被转换为一段描述，该描述在保留预期美学风格的同时不会产生衍生内容。

paragraphs.en: On the structural side, as described in Section 3.3 , the sanitizer enriches under-specified prompts into the structured signal format the world model expects: a) a seed image, b) a short synthetic video extension, and c) aligned control signals derived from the inverse dynamics model. This multi-feature approach means that the safety layer is not simply an optional filter but an integral component of the generation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 在结构方面，如第3.3节所述，净化器将规格不足的提示词丰富为世界模型所期望的结构化信号格式：a) 一张种子图像，b) 一段简短的合成视频扩展，以及 c) 由逆动力学模型导出的对齐控制信号。 这种多特征方法意味着安全层并非一个可有可无的简单过滤器，而是生成流程中不可或缺的组成部分。

sents.en: On the structural side, as described in Section 3.3 , the sanitizer enriches under-specified prompts into the structured signal format the world model expects: a) a seed image, b) a short synthetic video extension, and c) aligned control signals derived from the inverse dynamics model.
sents.zh: 在结构方面，如第3.3节所述，净化器将规格不足的提示词丰富为世界模型所期望的结构化信号格式：a) 一张种子图像，b) 一段简短的合成视频扩展，以及 c) 由逆动力学模型导出的对齐控制信号。

sents.en: This multi-feature approach means that the safety layer is not simply an optional filter but an integral component of the generation pipeline.
sents.zh: 这种多特征方法意味着安全层并非一个可有可无的简单过滤器，而是生成流程中不可或缺的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Early versions of the sanitizer returned structured information about the elements removed alongside the sanitized prompt, which was useful for debugging but introduced unnecessary complexity. The current system returns only the sanitized prompt, reducing latency and surface area for failure.
paragraphs.zh: 该净化器（sanitizer）的早期版本会在返回净化后提示词的同时，附带关于被移除元素的结构化信息，这对调试很有用，但引入了不必要的复杂性。 当前系统仅返回净化后的提示词，从而降低了延迟并减少了可能出现故障的环节。

sents.en: Early versions of the sanitizer returned structured information about the elements removed alongside the sanitized prompt, which was useful for debugging but introduced unnecessary complexity.
sents.zh: 该净化器（sanitizer）的早期版本会在返回净化后提示词的同时，附带关于被移除元素的结构化信息，这对调试很有用，但引入了不必要的复杂性。

sents.en: The current system returns only the sanitized prompt, reducing latency and surface area for failure.
sents.zh: 当前系统仅返回净化后的提示词，从而降低了延迟并减少了可能出现故障的环节。

paragraphs.en: Because world models generate content continuously and interactively, safety cannot rely solely on input filtering and output review. A prompt that passes all safety checks may nonetheless lead to unsafe visual states as the generated environment evolves in response to user actions.
paragraphs.zh: 由于世界模型是持续且交互式地生成内容的，安全性不能仅依赖输入过滤和输出审查。 一条通过所有安全检查的提示，仍可能随着生成环境对用户动作的响应演化而导致不安全的视觉状态。

sents.en: Because world models generate content continuously and interactively, safety cannot rely solely on input filtering and output review.
sents.zh: 由于世界模型是持续且交互式地生成内容的，安全性不能仅依赖输入过滤和输出审查。

sents.en: A prompt that passes all safety checks may nonetheless lead to unsafe visual states as the generated environment evolves in response to user actions.
sents.zh: 一条通过所有安全检查的提示，仍可能随着生成环境对用户动作的响应演化而导致不安全的视觉状态。

paragraphs.en: In addition to input and mid-generation safeguards, we apply post-generation analysis to completed outputs. Generated content passes through output classifiers before delivery to users.
paragraphs.zh: 除了输入和生成过程中的防护措施外，我们还对已完成的输出应用生成后分析。 生成的内容在交付给用户之前会经过输出分类器。

sents.en: In addition to input and mid-generation safeguards, we apply post-generation analysis to completed outputs.
sents.zh: 除了输入和生成过程中的防护措施外，我们还对已完成的输出应用生成后分析。

sents.en: Generated content passes through output classifiers before delivery to users.
sents.zh: 生成的内容在交付给用户之前会经过输出分类器。

paragraphs.en: Monitoring deployed systems requires visibility into what users are requesting and what the model is generating. We maintain moderation dashboards that track prompt distributions, flagged content rates, and generation outcomes over time.
paragraphs.zh: 监控已部署的系统需要洞察用户在请求什么内容，以及模型在生成什么内容。 我们维护审核仪表盘，跟踪随时间变化的提示词分布、被标记内容的比例以及生成结果。

sents.en: Monitoring deployed systems requires visibility into what users are requesting and what the model is generating.
sents.zh: 监控已部署的系统需要洞察用户在请求什么内容，以及模型在生成什么内容。

sents.en: We maintain moderation dashboards that track prompt distributions, flagged content rates, and generation outcomes over time.
sents.zh: 我们维护审核仪表盘，跟踪随时间变化的提示词分布、被标记内容的比例以及生成结果。

paragraphs.en: This monitoring serves multiple purposes: detecting emerging misuse patterns, identifying gaps in the filtering pipeline, and informing the prompt distribution analysis that guides future training data curation (see Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这种监控具有多重目的：检测新出现的滥用模式，识别过滤流程中的缺口，并为提示词分布分析提供依据，从而指导未来的训练数据整理工作（参见第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: Structured adversarial testing is a critical component of safety evaluation for generative systems. We conduct internal red-teaming before each major release, with team members attempting to elicit disallowed content through prompt manipulation, multi-step interaction sequences, and edge-case inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化对抗测试是生成式系统安全评估的关键组成部分。 我们在每次重大发布前进行内部红队测试，团队成员尝试通过提示词操纵、多步交互序列和边缘情况输入来诱导生成被禁止的内容。

sents.en: Structured adversarial testing is a critical component of safety evaluation for generative systems.
sents.zh: 结构化对抗测试是生成式系统安全评估的关键组成部分。

sents.en: We conduct internal red-teaming before each major release, with team members attempting to elicit disallowed content through prompt manipulation, multi-step interaction sequences, and edge-case inputs.
sents.zh: 我们在每次重大发布前进行内部红队测试，团队成员尝试通过提示词操纵、多步交互序列和边缘情况输入来诱导生成被禁止的内容。

paragraphs.en: As a small team, we recognize that internal perspectives are limited. We actively seek external input from researchers, artists, and community members, and maintain public channels for reporting problematic generations.

paragraphs.en: We have presented Waypoint-1.5, a 1.28B parameter single-stream causal Diffusion Transformer for real-time interactive video generation on consumer hardware. The system integrates frame-causal attention with a static rolling KV cache, Diffusion Forcing pretraining, Self-Forcing DMD post-training distillation, and the TAEHV 1.5 compact autoencoder, all trained on over 100,000 hours of controller-synchronized gameplay from the Owl-Control dataset. Together, these components enable stable long-horizon autoregressive rollout at 4 denoising steps per frame, with classifier-free guidance baked into the student during distillation rather than applied separately at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 Waypoint-1.5，这是一个拥有 12.8 亿参数的单流因果扩散 Transformer，用于在消费级硬件上实现实时交互式视频生成。 该系统集成了帧因果注意力与静态滚动 KV 缓存、Diffusion Forcing 预训练、Self-Forcing DMD 后训练蒸馏以及 TAEHV 1.5 紧凑自编码器，全部基于来自 Owl-Control 数据集的超过 10 万小时控制器同步游戏画面进行训练。 这些组件共同实现了稳定的长时间自回归生成，每帧仅需 4 个去噪步骤，并且无分类器引导在蒸馏阶段已内嵌到学生模型中，而无需在推理时单独施加。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarked across ten consumer NVIDIA GPUs, the INT8-quantized 720P variant meets the 30 latent FPS real-time threshold on all GPUs from the RTX 5060 Ti upward, and the 360P variant achieves this on all tested hardware including the RTX 3060. These results show that interactive, controllable video generation at real-time frame rates is achievable on hardware end users already own, without enterprise-level infrastructure or streamed delivery. We hope Waypoint-1.5 serves as a practical foundation for future research in real-time world models and interactive video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在十款消费级 NVIDIA GPU 上进行基准测试后，INT8 量化的 720P 版本在从 RTX 5060 Ti 起的所有 GPU 上均达到 30 latent FPS 的实时门槛，而 360P 版本在包括 RTX 3060 在内的所有受测硬件上均实现了这一目标。 这些结果表明，实时帧率的交互式、可控视频生成可以在终端用户已有的硬件上实现，无需企业级基础设施或流式传输方案。 我们希望 Waypoint-1.5 能为实时世界模型与交互式视频生成领域的未来研究提供一个实用的基础。
